title: Morning Brief — Thursday, 24 September 2026
description: Today: the federal Thriving Kids program launches October 1 with every state signed on except Queensland, sparking a Canberra-Brisbane standoff over funding and eligibility detail; and Gold Coast hinterland residents brace for smoke haze as hazard reduction burns continue around Mount Nathan, Clagiraba, Wongawallan, and Tamborine. Broadcast in English, followed by a full Korean-language version (오늘의 브리핑 영어 방송 후 한국어 전체 브리핑이 이어집니다).

show.channel_description: A short daily news brief covering Australian national news, Queensland, and the Gold Coast — made to listen to on the morning drive.
